verdict.rationale: First-party docs show v0 projects connecting to GitHub to keep code in a repository, pushing code directly, working on isolated branches, and publishing through pull requests with CI checks. Inbound flow is shown by Import from GitHub (a chat created at a chosen base branch) and by branch tools to Fix Conflicts or Fix CI, which imply reconciling changes made in the repo. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that commits made outside v0 continuously sync back into an existing v0 chat, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the two-way sync.
